sources.snippet: Kokoro-82M — Core AI The zoo's first text-to-speech model. hexgrad/Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) is a tiny, high-quality StyleTTS2 + iSTFTNet synthesizer — 82M parameters, 24 kHz output, non-autoregressive. Phonemes and a voice/style vector go in; a waveform comes out in one pass (no token-by-token decode). It runs fully on-device, English-first, with the grapheme→phoneme step on the host.

sources.title: Kokoro TTS | FluidInference/mobius | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Kokoro-82M is a StyleTTS2-based neural text-to-speech model converted to CoreML for on-device inference on iOS 17+ and macOS 14+. It generates natural-sounding multi-speaker speech at 24kHz with 8-12x real-time performance, optimized for Apple Neural Engine (ANE) and GPU execution.
